title: Smartoools RB40 AAA 1.5V 750mWh USB Type-C Rechargeable Lithium-ion Battery

tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
The Smartoools RB40 AAA 1.5V 750mWh USB Type-C Rechargeable Lithium-ion Battery is a high-performance power solution designed for modern electronic devices. With a stable 1.5V output and 750mWh capacity, it delivers reliable and long-lasting energy for remote controls, wireless keyboards, toys, cameras, flashlights, and other AAA-powered devices.


This battery features a convenient USB Type-C charging interface, allowing you to recharge directly with a standard USB-C cable without needing a separate charger. Built-in LED indicators show charging status, while advanced protection systems safeguard against overcharge, over-discharge, short circuits, and overheating for safe operation.


The Smartoools RB40 rechargeable battery supports up to around 1000–1200 charge cycles, making it a cost-effective and eco-friendly alternative to disposable AAA batteries. Its compact design and fast charging capability ensure reliable performance for both home and professional applications.


Key Features


  • 750mWh high-capacity rechargeable lithium-ion battery
  • Stable 1.5V constant output for reliable device performance
  • USB Type-C direct charging – no extra charger required
  • Built-in LED charging indicator
  • Fast charging in approximately 2 hours
  • Multiple protection systems: overcharge, over-discharge, short-circuit protection
  • Supports up to 1000+ recharge cycles
  • Eco-friendly and reusable battery solution
